text:
Hey there, [VAR 0100(0000)]!\c
You gave Raihan a good thrashing, and that
means you’ve completed the Gym Challenge!\c
Congratulations, from the bottom of my heart![VAR 0114(000B)]
I really wish we could go celebrate, but I think\nthere’re some things we should talk over.[VAR 0114(000B)]

That light that covered Hammerlocke...\c
It was just like the Darkest Day, where it’s said
that giant Pokémon went on a rampage and
almost destroyed the entire Galar region.[VAR 0114(000B)]

It certainly seems to be that way, my dear.\c
As you know, we Dynamax our Pokémon today
using the energy from Wishing Stars that have
fallen to us.[VAR 0114(000A)]

But we still don’t know how to fully control the
energy behind Dynamaxing or how the two
heroes managed to do so.\c
In fact, we’re not even really sure who—or what—
the two heroes actually were.[VAR 0114(000A)]
Sonia, my dearest...\nMy lab coat is yours now.[VAR 0114(000A)]
Are you sure, Gran? I still haven’t finished the\nwork you’ve assigned me.[VAR 0114(000B)]
Think of this as something to help you finish\nthat work.[VAR 0114(000A)]

The two heroes that protected the Galar region
from the Darkest Day...\c
And the legend of the sword and shield you just
mentioned... It’s up to you to figure out the truth
behind it all.[VAR 0114(000A)]

I’ll do what I can! You or Hop could be the one
to take down Leon, and I don’t want to miss that!\c
Not to worry—you can count on me to take care
of everything!\c
You just focus on getting to Wyndon. Go on!
Head to the station, or you’ll miss your train![VAR 0114(000B)]
The station’s near Route 7, remember?\nNow, off with you, Gym Challenger![VAR 0114(000B)]

There are things that only young people like
you can do, and there are other things that
should be left to the adults.\c
Everyone has their own role.[VAR 0114(000A)]
